grouping.key: exact decimal values of first five metadata fields; channel is sixth field
grouping.requirements: 100 groups, ten distinct channels each, 100 distinct frequency labels; metadata columns 2,3,4 zero; rate1953125; frequency labels in[21000,41000]

split.train: sorted group index mod5 in{0,1,2}:60 groups

grouping.labels_are_not: certified physical drive, detuning, iid repetitions or independent preparation draws

extraction.mean: arithmetic mean over selected window, reported as nominal-voltage DC
extraction.sensitivity_taper: symmetric Hann w_n=(1-cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)))/2 on same demeaned window
extraction.dft: numpy float64 rfft, no zero-padding; one-sided energy weights2 exceptDC andNyquist; P_l=d_l*|DFT(w*(x-mean))_l|^2/(N*sum(w^2))
extraction.tie: first maximum in computed float64 powers (lower bin); no exact arithmetic frequency guarantee
extraction.zero_ac: dominant/centroid undefined(None), spectral-feature model score HOLD; do not invent zero frequency
extraction.sensitivity: report Hann-minus-rect dominant-bin and centroid for every row, no cherry-picked primary window
extraction.DC_order: PRE-demean cropmean; demean once before both spectra
extraction.constant_trace: If all cropped parsed float64 samples compare exactly equal, report that value asDC and set AC exactlyzero; no tolerance clipping.

descriptive_models.model_C: training-channel-feature median; even sample count uses arithmetic average of two middle sorted values
descriptive_models.model_L: piecewise-linear interpolation vs metadata frequency label, training only; outside training range constant nearest endpoint
descriptive_models.training: 60 groups only; every channel separately; fixed models, no hyperparameters or adaptive model selection
descriptive_models.validation: report MAE and max-absolute error for20groups; no tuning
descriptive_models.test: one report on20groups after frozen code/contract, MAE and max-absolute error
descriptive_models.reporting: raw feature units only, all10channels, paired per-group errors; no pvalue/SEM/95percent/independence/causal claim
descriptive_models.comparison: report bothmodels and signed error difference descriptively; neither is a gauge-preserving or gauge-breaking physical null
descriptive_models.missing_feature: HOLD affected channel-feature score; no deletion or imputation

uncertainty.descriptive_labels: metadata Hz and recorded nominal V, not independently calibrated SI guarantees
missing: sample-clock rate/skew/jitter calibration and anti-alias transfer
actual acquisition configuration connecting frequency label to controls
capacitor/frequency normalization and calibrated oscillator state map
uncertainty.deterministic_future_rule: If independently frozen per-sample voltage error bound epsilon is supplied, |mean_error|<=epsilon and |RMS_AC_error|<=epsilon (orthogonal mean removal is an l2 contraction); otherwise no numeric uncertainty interval. No Lipschitz peak-frequency bound without a proved spectral gap. Clock labels remain conditional. New uncertainty evidence requires separate version before inferential evaluation.
not_allowed: 15V software guard as calibrated ADC rail
zero metadata amplitude as evidence of all physical sources absent
uncertainty.numpy_rounding: No outward FFT/window/comparison rounding enclosure is implemented. All current floating results, including tie selection, are descriptive. Any future interval needs an independently certified numerical error allowance as well as acquisition bounds.

stop_rules: wrong compressed hash/bytecount: refuse before parsing
schema/nonfinite/missing or duplicate channel/group/unequal metadata: HOLD all outputs
rate/frequency-label range/distinct-count/zero-drive-field mismatch: HOLD, no automatic repair
calibrated clipping/linearity/phase/energy/Gauss/model-comparison claims: HOLD until separate pinned calibration/state-model contract
no extra sources, fits, tuned windows or repeats added under this version
